description: This file defines the EachPromise class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, implementing a promise that manages multiple concurrent promises, with configuration options for fulfillment, rejection, and concurrency control.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: A class that manages multiple promises, executing side-effects on fulfillment or rejection, with optional concurrency limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EachPromise with an iterable of promises or values and configuration options for concurrency, fulfillment, and rejection handlers.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the aggregate promise that represents the completion of all managed promises.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Creates the internal promise that manages the execution and resolution of the promises.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Refills the queue of pending promises based on the concurrency limit.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Adds a new promise to the pending list from the iterable.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, with locking to prevent recursion.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of a promise at a given index, refilling pending promises if needed.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks if all promises are settled and resolves the aggregate promise if so.
